label: Permissioned or external asset
summary: Use a controlled, wrapped or externally referenced asset with explicit issuer and legal trust.
requiredFacts: Asset role in the PoolKey: launched, quote or both
Asset issuer, ownership claim, redemption right and exact source of truth
Pause, blacklist, confiscation, mint, upgrade and transfer restrictions
Permission adapter, user eligibility and failure or depeg behavior
Public non-affiliation, backing and legal disclosures
requiredTests: Role-specific launched-asset, quote-asset and both-asset integration behavior
Pause, blacklist, confiscation, fee-on-transfer and callback behavior
Mint, burn, upgrade and redemption changes
Depeg, insolvency and provider incompatibility scenarios
risks: Token controls can block exits or confiscate balances
A paired external asset does not by itself provide legal backing
Provider or jurisdiction support can be narrower than protocol support
